summary.text: George Marsh, a Republican and Queens United Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in New York's 5th Congressional District to Gregory Meeks, receiving 19.3% of the vote to Meeks's 80.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He had advanced to the general election unopposed after the Republican primary was canceled.
Ballotpedia has not published a biography for him, he has not completed its Candidate Connection survey, and it lists $0 in campaign contributions for 2026.
